beats.text: Hanuman searched Ravana's palace room by room, past drunken guards, dancing halls and golden chambers, but found no Sita.
He saw Ravana asleep, surrounded by beautiful queens. For a moment he thought one was Sita, then shook his head. 'Sita would never sleep here, happy.'
He searched every house in Lanka. Nothing. He sat on a wall in despair. Had she died? Had he failed Rama?
At last he saw a garden of Ashoka trees, glowing in the moonlight.
Beneath one tree sat a thin, pale woman in plain, dusty yellow clothes, her hair in a single braid, her eyes full of tears.
Ferocious demonesses guarded her, with the faces of horses, boars and buffaloes. She wept, whispering Rama's name.
Hanuman hid in the branches above, his heart pounding. He had found her.
